evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'I want the next step, would you be able to put together an estimate? I just have some questions about the move specifically about 71015 minutes depending and then we can be able to give you a quote that you can depend on, sounds good.' — framing is present but the line is garbled ("71015 minutes"), delivery is rushed, and no clear pause for customer confirmation before pivoting to probing.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Rep asks for zip codes of pickup and dropoff (two of four). Name and moving day were provided by customer unprompted (Yvonne mentions 'October 1st'). Rep never explicitly asks for approximate home size or room count in Section 1; customer volunteers 'single family home' later in probing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves straight into probing (furniture details, layout questions) without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Partial. Rep gathers: property type (single family home → townhome/condo), furniture inventory (detailed by customer), access notes (one mile away, mentions easy access), destination type (townhome/condo). Missing: floor/stories, number of rooms in source home, special considerations beyond furniture coverage, additional stops. No systematic probing for these items.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full. Rep provides: '$190 for two movers, everything included (gas, truck, taxes, insurance, wrapping, disassembly/reassembly)' and anchors to move scope: 'two and a half hour minimum... if the move [is] two and a half hour or less, that's gonna be a total of $475 with two guys.' Personalized to this customer's stated small load (one living room + pieces).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full. Rep discloses: '$190 per hour (per two movers), everything included,' 'two and a half hour minimum,' 'time is prorated in fifteen minute increments,' 'no extra charges, no credit card fees, no transportation fees.' Also frames wrap/disassembly/reassembly as included upfront.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. After the $475 estimate, customer responds with hesitation ('I can't imagine you couldn't move that two and a half hours, but I've seen movers move a whole lot in two and a half hours. But okay'). Rep does not ask 'Does that feel fair?' or hold silence for customer reaction; instead moves into confirmation: 'Yup, that's the minimum. Yes.'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Not mentioned. No reference to on-time discount or guarantee.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Not mentioned. No reference to $2,000 no-deductible coverage or No Worries Damage Coverage.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Neither promise was delivered, so nothing to close the loop on.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Call transitions to customer saying 'she should be calling you sometime today for sure' without a genuine check for remaining concerns.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not mentioned. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' equivalent.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep says 'if she's able to call us back, so we can get all the complete details and set her up to Dana' — this is a soft defer to a future call, not a direct 'Would you like our help with your move?' asked to this customer or the daughter.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep confirms: rep's name (Dana), phone availability during day, notes that customer/daughter should call back for complete details. Missing: moving date confirmation (October 1st mentioned by customer but not confirmed back), phone number of customer/daughter, arrival window, crew size confirmation, addresses not fully confirmed (only zip codes 77024 and 'same neighborhood, one mile away' — no full addresses), no notes left for crew about concerns.

top_strength: Rep clearly explained the pricing structure (hourly rate, inclusions, minimum, increment probing) and anchored the estimate to the customer's specific small load ($475 for a 2.5-hour minimum move), which gave the customer transparency and confidence in the numbers.
coaching_note: Rep skipped the critical 'Their Agenda' question in Section 2, never asked 'What are your biggest concerns about this move?', and completely omitted the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) in Section 5 — both are foundational to the call; also never asked 'Does that feel fair?' after pricing or 'Would you like our help with your move?' before routing to a callback.
